title: Checkout fails when cart is empty
body: calculate_total throws on empty cart because get_cart_items returns an empty list and sum() over price keys fails.

title: Payment gateway timeout not retried
body: charge_card does not retry on gateway timeout, checkout_endpoint surfaces a raw 500 to the customer.

title: Receipt email sent to wrong address after profile update
body: send_receipt uses a stale cached email via _lookup_email instead of the latest profile email.
